Silent split authority: when `PF_BACKLOG_DB=on`, an unlisted/typo'd scope quietly stays file-authoritative (`_db_for` → False) with no log, metric or startup report; violates the "no silent fallback" guardrail and hides undetected drift for newly added generated products.

SUMMARY: The core cutover mechanics (default on, scoped allowlist, tenant-scoped PK/FK, export/backfill/parity tooling) are directionally right and the fail-closed path is largely in place.

Main new risks: an entire spec-chain framework shipping outside the approved design/review scope, silent per-scope file fallback with no observability, and inconsistent scope normalization that deviates from the frozen functional spec.
Prior PENDING blockers/majors (destructive prune, false-green parity, GUC-only tenant trust, one-way 0021) are still open and gate the merge.
